parity_status.notes: Active serving schema is phase7_68 (68 features: 58 base + 10 Phase 7). Artifacts are byte-for-byte compatible. Three slots (elo_league_adjusted, key_passes_under_pressure_diff, set_piece_xg_diff) are permanently DATA_GAP in PHASE7_FEATURES_ALWAYS_DATA_GAP — their vector positions exist and are always the registry default (0.0), never computed from live data. This is INTENTIONAL for artifact backward compatibility, NOT a silent default bug.

train_serve_invariants.same_default_semantics: All DATA_GAP slots use DEFAULT_FEATURE_VALUES_68 values; registry default is the only value ever used — nothing computes them from live data

ppda_ratio.note: Slot proxied as home_pressing_intensity (Elo-derived). Real PPDA exists in statsbomb_aggregator.py but has no live-serving resolution path. Consumer-copy gap: raw code leaks to UI via describeEvidenceCode(). Fix: add to EVIDENCE_CODE_COPY in full-analysis-contract.ts.

progressive_carry_diff.note: Slot present but always DATA_GAP at serving (no live StatsBomb event stream). Consumer-copy gap confirmed in §3.3 of v5 directive.

shot_quality_diff.note: In PHASE7_FEATURES_ALWAYS_DATA_GAP. Proxy ATE unreliable without real StatsBomb shot-map. Will remain DATA_GAP until StatsBomb corpus confirms ATE >= 0.02.

elo_league_adjusted.note: In PHASE7_FEATURES_ALWAYS_DATA_GAP. Collinear proxy with elo_difference, no independent ATE signal. Consumer-copy gap confirmed.

key_passes_under_pressure_diff.note: In PHASE7_FEATURES_ALWAYS_DATA_GAP. Proxy ATE=0.005, below 0.02 threshold. Consumer-copy gap confirmed.

set_piece_xg_diff.note: In PHASE7_FEATURES_ALWAYS_DATA_GAP. Mixed directional signal across leagues. Consumer-copy gap confirmed.
